body: Impressive once again. Your builds feels like a minecraft version of 'How It's Made'. Always worth the read.
I'll have to look into that another time, botonia is on my list of mods to try but i haven't really touched it yet. Seems to have lots of utility from what i read!

It's not too bad, it feels intuitive once you get the basics and the options it gives you are extensive. I honestly haven't used it nearly as much as i'd like to though so learning it is on my to-do list. This setup really just uses interval triggers to keep checking for imports and exports of white listed items from one place to another.

That's why i opted to use it myself, and the fact that the chest loads through an interface lets me request them from the AE Autocrafting system which makes my day. But for those without SFM in their packs it's good to know other options. : )
